notes.title: Update No. 4.0 - New Levels!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new 10 levels for single player with incredible quests and challenges.
[*] All levels are optimized and loaded faster.
[*] Improved game balance.
[*] Fixed bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Update No. 3.0 - Co-op Mode
notes.content:
Updated all levels of the cooperative mode for two players added new opponents. 
The levels of the single player and the cooperative mode differ, these are different levels with their own characteristics.

notes.title: Update No. 2.0 - Updated single mode.
notes.content: Fully updated 10 levels of single player mode, added one new opponent and many amazing funny elements.

notes.title: Update No. 1.0 - Cooperative mode and support for 9 languages!
notes.content:
The game added separately [b]co-operative[/b] and single mode. In the two-player mode, the levels will be twice as difficult, there will be more opponents. Also, you can play co-op mode alone when switching between players.

[b]Added a choice of levels.[/b]

The game interface is translated into [b]English, Chinese, Korean, Russian, Spanish, Hindi, French and German.[/b]
